name: Akhan Un Fabrikasi Ve Tarim Urunleri Gida Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Akhan Un Fabrikasi Ve Tarim Urunleri Gida Sanayi Ticaret Anonim Sirketi, established in 2005 and headquartered in Adana, Turkey, specializes in the manufacturing, distribution, and worldwide export of various grains and associated food products. Its offerings notably include a range of flours specifically formulated for baking pastries, producing confectioneries, crafting phyllo dough, and making bread.
